name: Product-Led Growth
description: Companies where product, self-serve, and product-qualified motions drive acquisition — freemium/trial, docs, community, and collaboration loops.

attributes.label: Self-serve product
attributes.description: Users can sign up and use the product without talking to sales.
attributes.researchPrompt: For company {domain}, determine whether a user can sign up and start using the product without a sales conversation. Look for free signup, in-app onboarding, and Get started CTAs vs sales-gated demos only.
negativeSignals: Sales-gated demo-only access with no self-serve path

attributes.label: Freemium or trial
attributes.description: Free tier, freemium, or time-boxed trial.
attributes.researchPrompt: For company {domain}, find free tier, freemium, or time-boxed trial offers on pricing or product pages.
negativeSignals: Quote-only pricing with no free or trial path

attributes.label: Usage/seat pricing transparency
attributes.description: Public pricing by seats, usage, or credits with visible numbers.
attributes.researchPrompt: For company {domain}, find a public pricing page with seat, usage, or credit-based numbers rather than contact-us-only.
positiveSignals: Public pricing page with numeric plans
negativeSignals: Contact us only with no units or prices

attributes.label: Public docs / API
attributes.description: Public developer documentation, API reference, or SDKs.
attributes.researchPrompt: For company {domain}, find public developer docs, API reference, OpenAPI, or SDKs (docs subdomain or /docs).
negativeSignals: No public API or developer documentation

attributes.label: Community / content-led growth
attributes.description: Community, templates, education content, or open forums.
attributes.researchPrompt: For company {domain}, find community presence or content-led growth: Discord/Slack community, template gallery, tutorial hub, or education content.

attributes.label: Product analytics culture
attributes.description: Product metrics, experimentation, or PQL/PQA language.
attributes.researchPrompt: For company {domain}, find mentions of product metrics, activation/retention, experimentation, or PQL/PQA language in blogs or product pages.
negativeSignals: Pure sales-led narrative with no product metrics language

attributes.label: Collaboration / viral loops
attributes.description: Multiplayer, sharing, invites, or workspace collaboration.
attributes.researchPrompt: For company {domain}, find collaboration or viral-loop features: invite teammates, shared workspaces, public share links, or multiplayer editing.
negativeSignals: Single-user only with no share or invite
